items.headline: Deductions applied for non-payable items and consumables
items.explanation: The bill includes charges for laundry, cold or hot packs, and crepe bandages. Under non-payable item guidelines, these items are excluded from claim settlement unless optional cover is selected. These non-medical expenses flag a total amount at risk of {{flag.NON_PAYABLE.amount}}.
items.fix: Collect the non-payable expenses directly from the patient or check if an optional cover is active.

items.headline: Room rent exceeds the eligible policy limit
items.explanation: The patient occupied a Single private AC room which exceeds the daily cap allowed by the policy. Under policy:4.2, room rent charges exceeding the allowed limit must be borne by the insured person. This excess room rent puts {{flag.ROOM_RENT_EXCESS.amount}} at risk of deduction.
items.fix: Move the patient to an eligible room category or obtain written upgrade consent from the patient.

items.headline: Proportionate deductions applied to associated medical expenses
items.explanation: Because a room category higher than the eligible limit was chosen, proportionate deductions apply to associated medical expenses like surgeon, OT, and nursing fees. Under policy:4.3 and IRDAI guidelines, these associated fees are reduced proportionately, while items like pharmacy, implants, and diagnostics remain exempt. This results in an estimated deduction of {{flag.PROP_ROOM_RENT.amount}}.
items.fix: Move the patient to an eligible room category or obtain written upgrade consent for the proportionate charges.

items.headline: Mandatory co-payment applicable on admissible claim amount
items.explanation: The policy terms mandate a 10% co-payment on all admissible claim expenses under policy:7.4. This co-payment percentage is calculated on the admissible amount after applying room rent and non-payable deductions. The estimated co-payment amount payable by the patient is {{flag.COPAY.amount}}.
items.fix: Inform the patient about the mandatory co-payment deduction and collect this portion directly from them.
